about.description: CSCL is an exchange traded fund perpetual listed on BingX, tracking Direxion Daily CSCO Bull 2X ETF, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
